title.narrative: Affordable Resources for Egypt's Industrial Growth (RIndustry)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the RIndustry action is to change the culture of resource utilization in Egypts industry for enhanced economics and competition. Energy production, water extraction and/or recycling, and energy efficiency are targeted for this mission, and research & development (R&D) based, innovative and sustainable solutions are employed. Specific objectives of the action Specific objectives are set to achieve the above main goal while staying focused on short term impact within the project duration, and sustainability beyond conclusion of the project. These are enumerated as follows: 1. Mobilize the industry for embracing advanced, affordable resources. To include a platform to reach out to various industrial communities for dissemination of related technologies and emphasize their impact on the improvement of economics and competition. Awareness, training, and sharing of best practices are offered in face-to-face meetings and workshops. 2. Adapting to advanced resource utilization practices in a number of pilot projects in agro-food industries and resource-intensive industries. This entails implementation of resource solutions in three stages which guarantee adequate solutions-for-need and sustainability; (a) Preimplantation stage, including consultation and assessment of energy and water needs and energy efficiency, (b) Onsite implementation stage, including installation and commissioning of energy and water related technologies, and (c) Post implementation stage, including onsite training, and monitoring of installed resources and their impact on the pilot projects economics and competitiveness. 3. Support entrepreneurship in efficient resource utilization. Potential start-ups, which serve the objectives of project RIndustry for affordable resources for Egypts industrial growth, are incubated within an ecosystem, which provides physical and financial resources for their success and growth. 4. Ensure quality and sustainability of advanced, affordable resources for Egypts industry by establishing RIndustry Community, an R&D center under the umbrella of the applicant to reside within the ecosystem established in the Science & Innovation Park at the British University in Egypt (BUE). This is to involve the R&D communities and industrial stakeholders to capitalize on and integrate efforts of this action and previous efforts and outputs led by the applicant and co-applicants in renewable energy and water desalination to stimulate research and innovation driven developments and investments in this sector and maximize Return On Investment (ROI) and increase competitiveness of Egypts MSMEs in the Egyptian and global markets.
